method: same deterministic BM25 ranker, source code vs published commit-summary excerpts
scope: retrospective unblinded nine-question module location ranking, not a human or agent productivity study

questions.question: HTTP syntax token patterns and grammar
local and remote protocol validation errors
normalize case insensitive header field syntax
request response message and data event classes
legal client server protocol state transitions
buffer fragmented input and scan for delimiters
decode incoming chunked wire framing into events
serialize outgoing events into wire bytes
combine readers writers and state in the connection interface

limitations: Questions authored after seeing h11 and synthetic histories
History excerpts hand-selected from published commit messages
No timings or human/agent blinded comparison
Different corpus sizes and document lengths
